examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A short product page rendered from data: an opening `hero-section` in `hero`, then `customer-use-cases-section`, `faq-section` and a `closing-call-to-action-section` in `sections`, each entry an `_id` naming the section and the `props` bound onto it. The column draws a hatched gap before each band; the closing band draws the page's closing frame, so no gap follows it.

examples.name: Closings
examples.summary: Two closing bands in a row: the renderer turns the upper band's `hatch` off, so the page closes once, on the lower band's frame. Below, a page whose last band carries its own content closes on `{ _id: 'closing-call-to-action-section', props: { variant: 'frame' } }`, the frame alone with no gap before it.
